build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that knocks a vertical bar against a wall using define_task_template
create_dynamic_objects: create dynamic jar and bar objects in the PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and angle
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two bodies touching using C.update_task with SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL using C.set_meta on the task creator
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations by raising creator_lib.SkipTemplateParams when objects are out of bounds
